workflow.name: Public CCXT quickstart acceptance
workflow.scope: Linux release wheel and bundled CLI; anonymous public market data, backtest, and HTML report. No credentials were supplied, no private APIs were called, and no orders were sent.

exchange_results.message: Service unavailable from a restricted location according to Binance eligibility terms.

bitget_page_boundary_fix.root_cause: The Bitget historical candle endpoint returns candles after startTime. Advancing the cursor to the next interval skipped one candle at each 200-row page boundary.
bitget_page_boundary_fix.remediation: Overlap the next query at the prior page's last candle and accept only one identical boundary duplicate.
bitget_page_boundary_fix.hosted_acceptance: passed; 4,992 bars and zero missing intervals

scope_limitations: The workflow overall failed because the South Central US hosted runner received Binance HTTP 451; this does not establish Binance API behavior in other eligible regions.

OKX and Bitget results prove anonymous public-data quickstart, backtest, and report generation only. They do not prove authenticated APIs, testnet/live execution, connector maturity, account-specific fees, or strategy profitability.
The public quickstart workflow failure does not change exchange capability maturity states.
